newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in featureless trade, dealers said on Thursday.
They said most traders were sidelined ahead of tonight's release of the U.S. weekly jobless claims and November Philadelphia Federal Reserve report on area business.
Weekly jobless claims for the week ended November 16 is forecast to be around 332,000 compared with 328,000 reported in the previous week.
The Philadelphia Federal Reserve report on area business for November is expected to show a reading of 5.0 against October's reading of 5.3.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning on lack of fresh factors. Some people are waiting for possible direction from tonight's release of the (U.S.) weekly jobless claims and Philadelphia Federal Reserve survey," a local dealer said.
In day-to-day rates, Thursday/Friday, weekend and week-fixed were unchanged from Wednesday's common 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent, respectively.

Among longer dates, two-months was unchanged at 5-1/2 5-3/8 percent, four-months unchanged at 5-1/2 5-3/8, nine-months unchanged at 5-9/16 5-7/16 and twelve-months unchanged at 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent. -- P.Theseira (65-870-3085)
